charge_id.description: ID of the charge tied to this chargeback

stage.description: The stage describes the current phase of a chargeback dispute

status.description: The status field tracks the current state or outcome of a chargeback dispute, providing a comprehensive overview of its lifecycle

type.description: The type categorizes the chargeback based on whether it originates from a transaction within the same country (local) or across different countries (international)

due_datetime.description: The due_datetime specifies the exact date and time by which an action or response is required. This is typically used to set deadlines for submitting documentation or responding to a chargeback

created_datetime.description: The created_datetime indicates the exact date and time when the chargeback record was initially created in the system. This timestamp helps in tracking the age of the dispute

updated_datetime.description: The updated_datetime specifies the most recent date and time when any information related to the chargeback record was modified or updated. This helps in tracking the last activity on the dispute

settlement_id.description: ID of the settlement tied to this chargeback
